interpretations: Group advanced behaviour records by the trader type of their exactly matched transaction and trader, treating a missing trader type as a separate group. Count distinct matched transactions per group, divide each count by the sum of all group counts, and return only groups whose share is strictly greater than the average group share. Show the type, count, share, and difference from the average without rounding; return no rows if the average is missing.
queries:
WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type,
           COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count
    FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
    JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
group_shares AS (
    SELECT trader_type,
           transaction_count,
           1.0 * transaction_count
               / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM group_counts
),
with_average AS (
    SELECT trader_type,
           transaction_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM group_shares
)
SELECT trader_type,
       transaction_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS difference_from_average
FROM with_average
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
  AND share > average_share
